plugin-data.name: Static Site Generator
plugin-data.description: Crawl this site and write a fully static HTML copy to bl-content/static-build/. Useful for archiving, mirroring, or hosting the site without PHP.

sgj-section-action-subtitle: Crawls every public URL, copies referenced assets, rewrites links to document-relative paths, and writes the result to bl-content/static-build/. The admin area, drafts, and the bl-content databases are never included.
sgj-build-confirm: Generate the static site now? Existing files in bl-content/static-build/ will be overwritten.
sgj-exclude-paths-tip: One path per line. Any URL whose path starts with one of these is skipped (admin and bl-content/databases are always skipped).
sgj-max-urls-tip: Hard cap on the number of URLs the crawler will fetch in a single build.
sgj-build-locked: Another build appears to be in progress. If this is wrong, remove the lock file from the workspace and try again.
sgj-build-no-output-dir: Could not create the output directory.
sgj-howitworks-1: The crawler fetches each public URL via cURL as an anonymous visitor — your admin session is not forwarded.
sgj-howitworks-2: HTML pages are written as path/index.html so clean URLs keep working; all absolute and root-relative links are rewritten to document-relative paths.
sgj-howitworks-3: Referenced theme, upload, and core assets are copied verbatim from disk when possible; everything else falls back to an HTTP fetch.
sgj-howitworks-4: Admin URLs, the bl-content/databases JSON, and any path you list under Exclude paths are never written to the build.
